standard_prerequisites: Serre subcategories and quotient categories of abelian categories; the universal property of the quotient functor (Homology, serre-subcategory-is-kernel) and the faithful/quotient-by-kernel criterion (Homology, quotient-by-kernel-exact-functor)
Exactness of localization (Algebra, proposition-localization-exact) and S^{-1}M congruent to M tensor S^{-1}A (Algebra, tensor-localization)
core_obligations: M -> M tensor S^{-1}A is exact and kills T, hence descends to a functor Mod_A/T -> Mod_{S^{-1}A} by the universal property
M tensor S^{-1}A = 0 implies M in T, so the descended functor is faithful
Essentially surjective: N_A (N as A-module) is a preimage of N since N_A tensor S^{-1}A -> N, x tensor a/s -> (a/s) x, is an isomorphism
proof_roadmap: Descend the exact localization functor through the Serre quotient
Prove faithfulness via the kernel criterion and the tensor-localization identification
Prove essential surjectivity via the canonical preimage N_A and the explicit inverse isomorphism
